description: This file contains JavaScript code for controlling the visibility and behavior of desktop navigation elements in the Olivero theme for Drupal, including sticky header toggling, intersection observation for navigation positioning, and localStorage management for header state persistence.

methods.name: isDesktopNav
methods.description: Checks if the mobile navigation button is visible by inspecting its display style.

methods.name: stickyHeaderIsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the sticky header is currently enabled based on ARIA attribute.

methods.name: setStickyHeaderStorage
methods.description: Stores the sticky header expanded state in localStorage with an expiry of two weeks.

methods.name: updateStickyHeaderStorage
methods.description: Updates the sticky header state in localStorage if it exists.

methods.name: toggleStickyHeaderState
methods.description: Toggles the sticky header between expanded and collapsed states.

methods.name: getStickyHeaderStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the sticky header state from localStorage, considering expiry.

methods.name: toggleDesktopNavVisibility
methods.description: Toggles the 'is-fixed' class on header elements based on intersection ratio.

methods.name: getRootMargin
methods.description: Calculates the root margin for IntersectionObserver based on toolbar classes.

methods.name: monitorNavPosition
methods.description: Sets up an IntersectionObserver to monitor navigation position and toggle visibility.
